candidates.title: Structural Site Engineer
candidates.location: Canberra ACT or Goulburn NSW (field based)
candidates.content_text: ['Associate', 'Full-time', 'Civil Engineering']  About Us For more than 40 years, Residential Engineering has delivered practical engineering solutions to the residential construction industry across New South Wales. Our expertise spans structural and geotechnical engineering, inspections, surveying, and bespoke design services. With a focus on buildable, cost-effective outcomes, we combine responsive service with long-standing client relationships to help deliver successful residential projects with confidence. Residential Engineering is backed by Five Group, a national network of engineering, surveying, consulting, and professional services businesses. Through this connection, we benefit from shared expertise, strong operational support, and a collaborative network that strengthens our capability and creates opportunities for our people and clients across Australia and South-East Asia. Location: Canberra, ACT or Goulburn, NSW (Field-based & remote) Our Benefits Competitive salary package Remote working flexibility with autonomy in your day-to-day role Supportive and close-knit team environment Exposure to a variety of residential construction projects Ongoing training and professional development opportunities Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing initiatives Your Role As our Structural Site Engineer , you'll play a key role supporting residential construction projects across your region through site inspections, technical assessments and engineering advice. This is a predominantly field-based position suited to an engineer who enjoys being out on site, engaging with builders and contractors, and seeing projects firsthand. While inspections will make up majority of your workload, you'll also have opportunities to complete structural design work and technical engineering tasks during quieter periods. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, planning your inspection schedule, liaising directly with site contacts and delivering practical engineering solutions that support safe and compliant construction outcomes. What You’ll Do: Conduct structural inspections across residential construction projects. Plan and manage daily inspection schedules and travel efficiently across your region. Prepare and submit inspection outcomes, photographs and supporting documentation. Liaise with builders, site supervisors and project stakeholders regarding inspection findings. Provide practical engineering advice and recommendations relating to site compliance and construction outcomes. Assist with structural design work, including concrete, steel and timber structures, when inspection workloads permit. What You’ll Bring Tertiary qualifications in Civil or Structural Engineering. Training in Asbestos and Silica awareness would be ideal. Experience undertaking site inspections within the Australian construction industry. In this role, you'll: Be responsible for undertaking a range of maintenance support activities to support the section’s line management and maintenance delivery staff in order to facilitate the effective and efficient delivery of scheduled works. The Works Support Officer will also be responsible for: Preparing and managing contract documents, assisting with tenders, and helping administer contracts Supporting the planning and delivery of works by preparing management plans, maintaining training records, coordinating training and assessments, handling public enquiries, and carrying out asset inspections Collecting, maintaining and analysing project and works data using databases, and preparing clear reports for management Providing administrative support and advice to team members and acting as a point of contact for suppliers and customers when needed Helping maintain Quality, Work Health & Safety (WHS), and Environmental systems by keeping records up to date, conducting basic audits, and supporting system improvements Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and contributing to workplace changes by regularly reviewing systems and procedures Working closely with a team of Engineers and other delivery staff, you will help keep projects on track while contributing to continuous improvement and strong quality, safety and environmental practices. This is an onsite and location specific role. The successful candidate is required to be based in Russell Vale . For more information on this position and business unit, view the role description and information pack About You You are a highly organised administrator with strong project support experience and a keen eye for detail. You can effectively manage competing priorities, maintain accuracy and deliver quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment. You are confident using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word, and are comfortable working across a range of business systems, including Asset Vision. Your strong computer skills enable you to provide efficient administrative and procurement support. You are an effective communicator who can build positive relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Working collaboratively within a team, you communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
